MORE INFORMATION ABOUT 3D MODELS :
COCONUT PEELER IS AN AUTOMATIC MACHINE THAT IS DURABLE AND HEAVY-DUTYIT EFFECTIVELY PEELS COCONUTS SO IT IS TIME-SAVING, CONVENIENT AND PRACTICAL.COCONUT IS A MAIN CROP OF KONKAN REGION AND DEHUSKING OF COCONUT IS VERY NECESSARY STEP IN MAKING THE COCONUT READY FOR FURTHER UTILIZATION. COCONUT DEHUSKING INVOLVES REMOVING OF THE HUSK FROM THE COCONUT. TRADITIONAL DEHUSKING IS TIME CONSUMING AND DIFFICULT PROCESS.THIS COCONUT DEHUSKING MACHINE PEELS OFF THE COCONUT HUSK FROM COCONUT FRUIT TO OBTAIN DEHUSKED COCONUT FRUIT WITH THE HELP OF TWO ROTATING ROLLERS HAVING SPIKES ON THEIR PERIPHERY. THE COCONUT IS PLACED IN BETWEEN THE ROLLERS LENGTHWISE. THE ROLLERS ARE DRIVEN AT TWO DIFFERENT SPEEDS WITH HELP OF GEARS AND POWERED BY ELECTRIC MOTOR.

description_text:
These bottles are low poly 3d models for your game projects like MMORPG, strategy, third person, fantasy, medieval, pirate, etc.You can use these models like rum bottles, potions, bar bottles.There are 8 unique models of bottles + 4 models of plugs + 5 bottles cabinets combinations, for a total of 70 models.There are 9 bottles colors + 4 cap colors.
Features/Specs:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for games.

  - Units used: centimeters. All models are saved separately. 

  - A file containing them all has also been inserted.

  - The models do not contain N-Gons, only quads and tris.

  - Objects are named according to their real purpose, allowing to easily find them.

  - Models are fully textured with correctly named materials and maps.

  - All textures are included (diffuse, bump, specular).

  - Textures format: PNG.

  - All objects have fully unwrapped UVs.

  - Lights and cameras are not included with models.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Ready to use.

  - The skull, books, room, chair, candle and other models in presentation scene are NOT in this pack.

Textures:

  - bottles.png - 2048x2048

  - bottles.bump.png - 2048x2048

description_text:
This is a 3D model of a chocolate cake with cherries, candy canes, and  peanut chocolate balls. 
The file will open and render like on thumbnails. No specific plugins or addons are need to open or render.
The materials in the scene have been developed using cycles nodes and internal shaders/colours. No ready made textures have been used in this model. 
The node-composited materials make it very easy to change colour without any errors. Plus, the design is quite simple and has clean topology. It guarantees a smooth modification process if need be. 
The design is at the centre of the scene and comes with its lighting setting. It can be re-scaled if needed. Also, the berries, chocolate balls, and candy canes can be deleted, modified, or moved easily to give the cake a new decoration.
File formats other than the ones listed  can  be provided upon request.

 The pimento pepper model is presented as single mesh in 2 versions. Mesh is quad based. Base model polycount is 3297. High detail model included in .max and .obj formats. High detail model has 808k quads. 

  -  Materials 
 .max 2014 files come with corona(1.5) and vray(3.4) materials. Other versions have basic materials, so you will need to adjust them in connection with your particular software.

  - Textures
 5 maps are supplied with this model. 8192×8192 PNGs and downsampled versions in 2048×2048 JPGs. The maps include ao, diffuse, glossiness, normal, displacement. A 16K diffuse texture is also included. The pimiento pepper model is uvw unwrapped.

  -  Formats
 The original file was created in 3ds Max 2014 with Corona and Vray materials (1.5 and 3.4). You will receive a 3DS, OBJ, LWO, FBX, SKP, C4D, 3DM and MAX file(2014). If you need any other format please enquire via CGTrader.

  -  Information 
 All preview images were rendered with Corona. You will get only the paprika bell and not the scenes used for the preview renders. Please also take into consideration that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of bell pepper 3d model in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your own scene. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. The model is clean and alone in the provided files, centred at origin and has real-world scale.
